title: Braised Fish Papillote with Gooey Glaze
description: A flavorful and tender fish dish cooked in a paper pouch with a sweet and sticky gooey glaze.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet (such as flounder or tilapia)
Papillote paper
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Place a piece of papillote paper on a flat surface.
Place a fish fillet in the center of the paper.
Drizzle with winey white wine and spoonful of gooey glaze.
Fold the paper over the fish to form a pouch, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the pouch in a baking dish and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
